verdict.rationale: Drive exposes API primitives (push notifications/watch, file properties, list/query) that developers can use to build background automations, and docs mention building an AI agent add-on with ADK/Vertex AI Agent Engine and creating files from Form submissions, implying some automation capability. However there's no evidence of a native, user-facing way to configure autonomous background automations directly within Drive itself (e.g., no-code triggers, scheduled agents) — it relies on third-party developer work. Missing for 10: first-party no-code automation/agent builder, documented autonomous scheduling, and independent confirmation of AI agent add-ons actually running unattended.
